data.title: Ripple, Stripe-owned Privy partner to bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
data.summary_raw: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.

data.title: Interactive Brokers expands crypto services with Ethereum staking via Zerohash
data.summary_raw: Interactive Brokers now lets eligible clients stake ETH through its Client Portal, with zerohash providing the service.

data.title: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
data.summary_raw: DRW and Marex completed the first OTC swap referencing a fully tokenized index on Derivnex via the Canton Network, with Kaiko data.

data.title: Ledger confirms hardware implant in CryptoBilis reseller units as MediaMarkt suspends sales in Europe
data.summary_raw: Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in CryptoBilis-sold devices steals recovery phrases, as MediaMarkt suspends sales.
